# SportConnect Frontend — React + Vite + TypeScript

Implementation follows the architecture doc: React 18 + Vite + TS, Leaflet/react-leaflet for the map, TanStack Query for data-fetching/caching, native `EventSource` for SSE notifications with visibility-based reconnect, JWT auth via Axios interceptor, Docker/Nginx for static serving.

> **Assumption flagged for Backend/Shared review:** the browser `EventSource` API cannot send custom `Authorization` headers. The SSE client below authenticates by appending `?access_token=<jwt>` to the stream URL. Backend must accept the token via query param on `GET /api/notifications/stream` (in addition to/instead of the header) for this to work. Please confirm in the API contract.

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';

// Dev proxy routes /api/* to the local Spring Boot backend so the SPA
// can call relative paths in both dev and prod (matches Nginx routing in prod).
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  server: {
    port: 5173,
    proxy: {
      '/api': {
        target: 'http://localhost:8080',
        changeOrigin: true,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    sourcemap: false,
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        // Code-split the Leaflet/map stack into its own chunk (perf target: <2s on 4G)
        manualChunks: {
          leaflet: ['leaflet', 'react-leaflet', 'react-leaflet-cluster'],
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

// Types mirror the API Contract exactly as defined by the Architect.

export type SportType =
  | 'FOOTBALL'
  | 'BASKETBALL'
  | 'TENNIS'
  | 'VOLLEYBALL'
  | 'RUNNING'
  | 'OTHER';

export type EventStatus = 'OPEN' | 'FULL' | 'CANCELLED' | 'COMPLETED';

export interface LatLng {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
}

export interface EventDTO {
  id: string;
  sportType: SportType;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  location: LatLng;
  addressLabel: string;
  startTime: string; // ISO8601
  durationMinutes: number;
  maxParticipants: number;
  currentParticipants: number;
  participantIds: string[];
  organizerId: string;
  status: EventStatus;
  isOwnedByCurrentUser: boolean;
  isJoinedByCurrentUser: boolean;
}

export interface EventListResponse {
  items: EventDTO[];
  total: number;
}

export interface CreateEventRequest {
  sportType: SportType;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  location: LatLng;
  addressLabel: string;
  startTime: string;
  durationMinutes: number;
  maxParticipants: number;
}

export type UpdateEventRequest = CreateEventRequest;

export interface EventFilters {
  sportType?: SportType | '';
  startAfter?: string;
  startBefore?: string;
  lat?: number;
  lng?: number;
  radiusKm?: number;
}

export interface RegisterRequest {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  displayName: string;
}

export interface RegisterResponse {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  displayName: string;
}

export interface LoginRequest {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export interface AuthUser {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  displayName: string;
}

export interface LoginResponse {
  accessToken: string;
  expiresIn: number;
  user: AuthUser;
}

export interface UserDTO {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  displayName: string;
  preferredSports: SportType[];
  homeLocation?: LatLng;
}

export interface UpdateUserRequest {
  displayName: string;
  preferredSports: SportType[];
  homeLocation?: LatLng;
}

export interface UsersEventsResponse {
  items: EventDTO[];
}

// Standard backend error shape
export interface ApiErrorShape {
  timestamp?: string;
  status: number;
  error?: string;
  message: string;
  path?: string;
}

// SSE event frame payloads
export interface NewGamePayload {
  eventId: string;
  sportType: SportType;
  distanceKm: number;
}

export interface RosterChangePayload {
  eventId: string;
  currentParticipants: number;
  maxParticipants: number;
}

export interface EventCancelledPayload {
  eventId: string;
}

export interface HeartbeatPayload {
  ts: string;
}

### `frontend/src/lib/tokenStore.ts`

```ts
// Simple module-level persistence for the JWT + cached user profile.
// Kept separate from React context/apiClient to avoid circular imports.

const TOKEN_KEY = 'sportconnect_token';
const USER_KEY = 'sportconnect_user';

export function getToken(): string | null {
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function setToken(token: string): void {
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export function clearToken(): void {
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
}

export function getStoredUser<T>(): T | null {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
  return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as T) : null;
}

export function setStoredUser(user: unknown): void {
  localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}
```

### `frontend/src/lib/apiClient.ts`

```ts
import axios, { type AxiosError } from 'axios';
import { getToken, clearToken } from './tokenStore';
import type { ApiErrorShape } from '../types/api';

export const API_BASE_URL: string = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api';

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

// Attach Bearer token to every request when present.
apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = getToken();
  if (token) {
    config.headers = config.headers ?? {};
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// Normalize errors to the backend's standard error shape and
// force a clean logout on 401 (expired/invalid token) instead of crash-looping.
apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error: AxiosError<ApiErrorShape>) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      clearToken();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:unauthorized'));
    }
    return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
  }
);

function normalizeError(error: AxiosError<ApiErrorShape>): ApiErrorShape {
  if (error.response?.data?.message) {
    return error.response.data;
  }
  return {
    status: error.response?.status ?? 0,
    error: 'Network Error',
    message: error.message || 'Network error. Please try again.',
  };
}
```

import type { ApiErrorShape } from '../types/api';

export function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'message' in error) {
    return (error as ApiErrorShape).message || 'Something went wrong.';
  }
  return 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
}

### `frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx`

```tsx
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { apiClient } from '../lib/apiClient';
import {
  getToken,
  setToken,
  clearToken,
  getStoredUser,
  setStoredUser,
} from '../lib/tokenStore';
import type {
  AuthUser,
  LoginRequest,
  LoginResponse,
  RegisterRequest,
  RegisterResponse,
} from '../types/api';

interface AuthContextValue {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  token: string | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  login: (creds: LoginRequest) => Promise<void>;
  register: (data: RegisterRequest) => Promise<RegisterResponse>;
  logout: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [token, setTokenState] = useState<string | null>(() => getToken());
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthUser | null>(() => getStoredUser<AuthUser>());
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const logout = useCallback(() => {
    clearToken();
    setTokenState(null);
    setUser(null);
  }, []);

  // React to 401 responses raised anywhere in the app (see apiClient interceptor)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = () => logout();
    window.addEventListener('auth:unauthorized', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:unauthorized', handler);
  }, [logout]);

  const login = useCallback(async (creds: LoginRequest) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<LoginResponse>('/auth/login', creds);
      setToken(data.accessToken);
      setStoredUser(data.user);
      setTokenState(data.accessToken);
      setUser(data.user);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const register = useCallback(async (payload: RegisterRequest) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<RegisterResponse>('/auth/register', payload);
      return data;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const value: AuthContextValue = {
    user,
    token,
    isAuthenticated: !!token,
    isLoading,
    login,
    register,
    logout,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used within AuthProvider');
  return ctx;
}
```

### `frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { apiClient } from '../lib/apiClient';
import type {
  CreateEventRequest,
  EventDTO,
  EventFilters,
  EventListResponse,
  UpdateEventRequest,
} from '../types/api';

const EVENTS_KEY = 'events';

function buildParams(filters: EventFilters): Record<string, string | number> {
  const params: Record<string, string | number> = {};
  if (filters.sportType) params.sportType = filters.sportType;
  if (filters.startAfter) params.startAfter = filters.startAfter;
  if (filters.startBefore) params.startBefore = filters.startBefore;
  if (filters.lat !== undefined) params.lat = filters.lat;
  if (filters.lng !== undefined) params.lng = filters.lng;
  if (filters.radiusKm !== undefined) params.radiusKm = filters.radiusKm;
  return params;
}

export function useEvents(filters: EventFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY, filters],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.get<EventListResponse>('/events', {
        params: buildParams(filters),
      });
      return data;
    },
  });
}

export function useEvent(id: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY, id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.get<EventDTO>(`/events/${id}`);
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}

export function useCreateEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (payload: CreateEventRequest) => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<EventDTO>('/events', payload);
      return data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY] }),
  });
}

export function useUpdateEvent(id: string) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (payload: UpdateEventRequest) => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.put<EventDTO>(`/events/${id}`, payload);
      return data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY] });
      queryClient.setQueryData([EVENTS_KEY, id], data);
    },
  });
}

export function useDeleteEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) => {
      await apiClient.delete(`/events/${id}`);
      return id;
    },
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY] }),
  });
}

export function useJoinEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<EventDTO>(`/events/${id}/join`);
      return data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY] });
      queryClient.setQueryData([EVENTS_KEY, data.id], data);
    },
  });
}

export function useLeaveEvent() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) => {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<EventDTO>(`/events/${id}/leave`);
      return data;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [EVENTS_KEY] });
      queryClient.setQueryData([EVENTS_KEY, data.id], data);
    },
  });
}
```

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

    },
  });
}

### `frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type { LatLng } from '../types/api';

interface GeoState {
  position: LatLng | null;
  error: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
}

export function useGeolocation() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<GeoState>({
    position: null,
    error: null,
    loading: false,
  });

  const requestLocation = useCallback(() => {
    if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) {
      setState({ position: null, error: 'Geolocation is not supported by this browser.', loading: false });
      return;
    }
    setState((s) => ({ ...s, loading: true, error: null }));
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        setState({
          position: { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude },
          error: null,
          loading: false,
        });
      },
      (err) => {
        // Fails gracefully -> caller falls back to manual address entry / default center.
        setState({ position: null, error: err.message || 'Unable to retrieve your location.', loading: false });
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 8000 }
    );
  }, []);

  const setManualPosition = useCallback((position: LatLng) => {
    setState({ position, error: null, loading: false });
  }, []);

  return { ...state, requestLocation, setManualPosition };
}
```

### `frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts`

```ts
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../components/common/ToastContext';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../lib/apiClient';
import type {
  EventCancelledPayload,
  NewGamePayload,
  RosterChangePayload,
} from '../types/api';

const MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS = 5;

/**
 * Manages a single EventSource connection to /notifications/stream.
 * - Closes the connection when the tab is hidden (document.visibilitychange)
 * - Reconnects with exponential backoff (capped at 5 attempts) when the tab
 *   becomes visible again or the connection drops unexpectedly.
 *
 * NOTE: EventSource cannot set an Authorization header, so the JWT is passed
 * as a query param. Backend must accept `access_token` on the stream endpoint.
 */
export function useNotifications(): void {
  const { token, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { pushToast } = useToast();

  const esRef = useRef<EventSource | null>(null);
  const attemptsRef = useRef(0);
  const reconnectTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated || !token) {
      return;
    }

    function connect() {
      const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/notifications/stream?access_token=${encodeURIComponent(token as string)}`;
      const es = new EventSource(url);
      esRef.current = es;

      es.onopen = () => {
        attemptsRef.current = 0;
      };

      es.addEventListener('new-game', (evt) => {
        const payload: NewGamePayload = JSON.parse((evt as MessageEvent).data);
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] });
        pushToast(
          `New ${payload.sportType} game nearby (${payload.distanceKm.toFixed(1)} km away)`,
          'info'
        );
      });

      es.addEventListener('roster-change', (evt) => {
        const payload: RosterChangePayload = JSON.parse((evt as MessageEvent).data);
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events', payload.eventId] });
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] });
        pushToast(
          `Roster updated: ${payload.currentParticipants}/${payload.maxParticipants} joined`,
          'info'
        );
      });

      es.addEventListener('event-cancelled', (evt) => {
        const payload: EventCancelledPayload = JSON.parse((evt as MessageEvent).data);
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events', payload.eventId] });
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] });
        pushToast('An event you are part of was cancelled.', 'error');
      });

      es.addEventListener('heartbeat', () => {
        // keep-alive ping from backend (~30s) — no UI action needed
      });

      es.onerror = () => {
        es.close();
        esRef.current = null;
        scheduleReconnect();
      };
    }

    function scheduleReconnect() {
      if (document.hidden) return; // don't burn attempts while tab is hidden
      if (attemptsRef.current >= MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS) return;
      const delay = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attemptsRef.current, 30_000);
      attemptsRef.current += 1;
      reconnectTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(connect, delay);
    }

    function handleVisibilityChange() {
      if (document.hidden) {
        esRef.current?.close();
        esRef.current = null;
        if (reconnectTimerRef.current) {
          window.clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
          reconnectTimerRef.current = null;
        }
      } else {
        attemptsRef.current = 0;
        if (!esRef.current) {
          connect();
        }
      }
    }

    connect();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      if (reconnectTimerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
      esRef.current?.close();
      esRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [isAuthenticated, token, queryClient, pushToast]);
}
```

### `frontend/src/components/common/ToastContext.tsx`

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

export type ToastVariant = 'info' | 'success' | 'error';

export interface ToastMessage {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  variant: ToastVariant;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  toasts: ToastMessage[];
  pushToast: (message: string, variant?: ToastVariant) => void;
  dismissToast: (id: string) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastMessage[]>([]);

  const dismissToast = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const pushToast = useCallback(
    (message: string, variant: ToastVariant = 'info') => {
      const id = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
      setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, variant }]);
      setTimeout(() => dismissToast(id), 5000);
    },
    [dismissToast]
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ toasts, pushToast, dismissToast }}>
      {children}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast(): ToastContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useToast must be used within ToastProvider');
  return ctx;
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { MapContainer, Marker, Popup, TileLayer, useMap } from 'react-leaflet';
import MarkerClusterGroup from 'react-leaflet-cluster';
import L from 'leaflet';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import type { EventDTO, LatLng, SportType } from '../../types/api';

const SPORT_EMOJI: Record<SportType, string> = {
  FOOTBALL: '⚽',
  BASKETBALL: '🏀',
  TENNIS: '🎾',
  VOLLEYBALL: '🏐',
  RUNNING: '🏃',
  OTHER: '🏆',
};

function buildIcon(sportType: SportType) {
  const emoji = SPORT_EMOJI[sportType] ?? SPORT_EMOJI.OTHER;
  return L.divIcon({
    html: `<div class="event-pin">${emoji}</div>`,
    className: 'event-pin-wrapper',
    iconSize: [32, 32],
    iconAnchor: [16, 32],
  });
}

function RecenterOnChange({ center }: { center: LatLng }) {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    map.setView([center.lat, center.lng], map.getZoom());
  }, [center.lat, center.lng, map]);
  return null;
}

interface EventMapProps {
  events: EventDTO[];
  center: LatLng;
}

export function EventMap({ events, center }: EventMapProps) {
  return (
    <MapContainer
      center={[center.lat, center.lng]}
      zoom={13}
      style={{ height: '100%', width: '100%' }}
      scrollWheelZoom
    >
      <RecenterOnChange center={center} />
      <TileLayer
        attribution="&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"
        url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
      />
      <MarkerClusterGroup chunkedLoading>
        {events.map((event) => (
          <Marker
            key={event.id}
            position={[event.location.lat, event.location.lng]}
            icon={buildIcon(event.sportType)}
          >
            <Popup>
              <div className="map-popup">
                <h4>{event.title}</h4>
                <p>
                  {event.sportType} · {new Date(event.startTime).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {event.currentParticipants}/{event.maxParticipants} joined
                </p>
                <Link to={`/events/${event.id}`}>View details</Link>
              </div>
            </Popup>
          </Marker>
        ))}
      </MarkerClusterGroup>
    </MapContainer>
  );
}
```

### `frontend/src/components/events/EventFilterPanel.tsx`

```tsx
import type { EventFilters, SportType } from '../../types/api';

const SPORT_OPTIONS: (SportType | '')[] = [
  '',
  'FOOTBALL',
  'BASKETBALL',
  'TENNIS',
  'VOLLEYBALL',
  'RUNNING',
  'OTHER',
];

interface EventFilterPanelProps {
  filters: EventFilters;
  onChange: (filters: EventFilters) => void;
  onUseMyLocation: () => void;
  locationLoading: boolean;
}

export function EventFilterPanel({
  filters,
  onChange,
  onUseMyLocation,
  locationLoading,
}: EventFilterPanelProps) {
  function update<K extends keyof EventFilters>(key: K, value: EventFilters[K]) {
    onChange({ ...filters, [key]: value });
  }

  return (
    <aside className="filter-panel">
      <h3>Filters</h3>

      <label>
        Sport
        <select
          value={filters.sportType ?? ''}
          onChange={(e) => update('sportType', e.target.value as SportType | '')}
        >
          {SPORT_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
            <option key={opt} value={opt}>
              {opt === '' ? 'All sports' : opt}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>

      <label>
        Starting after
        <input
          type="datetime-local"
          value={filters.startAfter ? toLocalInputValue(filters.startAfter) : ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            update('startAfter', e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value).toISOString() : undefined)
          }
        />
      </label>

      <label>
        Starting before
        <input
          type="datetime-local"
          value={filters.startBefore ? toLocalInputValue(filters.startBefore) : ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            update('startBefore', e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value).toISOString() : undefined)
          }
        />
      </label>

      <label>
        Radius (km): {filters.radiusKm ?? 10}
        <input
          type="range"
          min={1}
          max={50}
          value={filters.radiusKm ?? 10}
          onChange={(e) => update('radiusKm', Number(e.target.value))}
        />
      </label>

      <button type="button" onClick={onUseMyLocation} disabled={locationLoading}>
        {locationLoading ? 'Locating…' : '📍 Use my location'}
      </button>
    </aside>
  );
}

function toLocalInputValue(iso: string) {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(
    d.getMinutes()
  )}`;
}
```

### `frontend/src/components/events/EventForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { CreateEventRequest, EventDTO, LatLng, SportType } from '../../types/api';

const SPORT_OPTIONS: SportType[] = [
  'FOOTBALL',
  'BASKETBALL',
  'TENNIS',
  'VOLLEYBALL',
  'RUNNING',
  'OTHER',
];

interface EventFormProps {
  initialValue?: EventDTO;
  defaultLocation?: LatLng;
  onSubmit: (payload: CreateEventRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  submitLabel: string;
  isSubmitting?: boolean;
}

function toDateTimeLocal(iso?: string) {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(
    d.getMinutes()
  )}`;
}

export function EventForm({
  initialValue,
  defaultLocation,
  onSubmit,
  submitLabel,
  isSubmitting,
}: EventFormProps) {
  const [sportType, setSportType] = useState<SportType>(initialValue?.sportType ?? 'FOOTBALL');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initialValue?.title ?? '');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(initialValue?.description ?? '');
  const [addressLabel, setAddressLabel] = useState(initialValue?.addressLabel ?? '');
  const [lat, setLat] = useState(initialValue?.location.lat ?? defaultLocation?.lat ?? 48.8566);
  const [lng, setLng] = useState(initialValue?.location.lng ?? defaultLocation?.lng ?? 2.3522);
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(toDateTimeLocal(initialValue?.startTime));
  const [durationMinutes, setDurationMinutes] = useState(initialValue?.durationMinutes ?? 60);
  const [maxParticipants, setMaxParticipants] = useState(initialValue?.maxParticipants ?? 10);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Client-side validation mirrors backend Bean Validation rules; NOT a security boundary.
  function validate(): string | null {
    if (!title.trim()) return 'Title is required.';
    if (!addressLabel.trim()) return 'Address is required.';
    if (!startTime) return 'Start time is required.';
    if (lat < -90 || lat > 90) return 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90.';
    if (lng < -180 || lng > 180) return 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180.';
    if (durationMinutes <= 0) return 'Duration must be greater than 0.';
    if (maxParticipants <= 1) return 'Max participants must be at least 2.';
    return null;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const error = validate();
    if (error) {
      setFormError(error);
      return;
    }
    setFormError(null);
    const payload: CreateEventRequest = {
      sportType,
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim(),
      location: { lat, lng },
      addressLabel: addressLabel.trim(),
      startTime: new Date(startTime).toISOString(),
      durationMinutes,
      maxParticipants,
    };
    await onSubmit(payload);
  }

  return (
    <form className="event-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      {formError && (
        <div className="error-banner" role="alert">
          {formError}
        </div>
      )}

      <label>
        Sport
        <select value={sportType} onChange={(e) => setSportType(e.target.value as SportType)}>
          {SPORT_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s}>
              {s}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>

      <label>
        Title
        <input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={120} required />
      </label>

      <label>
        Description
        <textarea value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} maxLength={2000} />
      </label>

      <label>
        Address
        <input value={addressLabel} onChange={(e) => setAddressLabel(e.target.value)} required />
      </label>

      <div className="event-form__row">
        <label>
          Latitude
          <input
            type="number"
            step="0.0001"
            value={lat}
            onChange={(e) => setLat(Number(e.target.value))}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          Longitude
          <input
            type="number"
            step="0.0001"
            value={lng}
            onChange={(e) => setLng(Number(e.target.value))}
            required
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <label>
        Start time
        <input
          type="datetime-local"
          value={startTime}
          onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </label>

      <div className="event-form__row">
        <label>
          Duration (minutes)
          <input
            type="number"
            min={15}
            step={15}
            value={durationMinutes}
            onChange={(e) => setDurationMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          Max participants
          <input
            type="number"
            min={2}
            value={maxParticipants}
            onChange={(e) => setMaxParticipants(Number(e.target.value))}
            required
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
        {isSubmitting ? 'Saving…' : submitLabel}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { EventMap } from '../components/map/EventMap';
import { EventFilterPanel } from '../components/events/EventFilterPanel';
import { useEvents } from '../hooks/useEvents';
import { useGeolocation } from '../hooks/useGeolocation';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';
import { LoadingSpinner } from '../components/common/LoadingSpinner';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import type { EventFilters, LatLng } from '../types/api';

const DEFAULT_CENTER: LatLng = { lat: 48.8566, lng: 2.3522 }; // Paris fallback

export function MapPage() {
  const { position, requestLocation, loading: locating } = useGeolocation();
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<EventFilters>({ radiusKm: 10 });

  const center = position ?? DEFAULT_CENTER;

  const effectiveFilters = useMemo<EventFilters>(
    () => ({
      ...filters,
      lat: filters.lat ?? center.lat,
      lng: filters.lng ?? center.lng,
    }),
    [filters, center]
  );

  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useEvents(effectiveFilters);

  return (
    <div className="map-page">
      <EventFilterPanel
        filters={filters}
        onChange={setFilters}
        onUseMyLocation={requestLocation}
        locationLoading={locating}
      />
      <div className="map-page__map">
        {isError && <ErrorBanner message={getErrorMessage(error)} />}
        {isLoading ? <LoadingSpinner /> : <EventMap events={data?.items ?? []} center={center} />}
      </div>
      <div className="map-page__list">
        <h3>{data?.total ?? 0} events found</h3>
        <ul>
          {data?.items.map((event) => (
            <li key={event.id}>
              <Link to={`/events/${event.id}`}>{event.title}</Link> — {event.sportType} —{' '}
              {new Date(event.startTime).toLocaleString()}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

### `frontend/src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useDeleteEvent, useEvent, useJoinEvent, useLeaveEvent } from '../hooks/useEvents';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';
import { LoadingSpinner } from '../components/common/LoadingSpinner';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../components/common/ToastContext';

export function EventDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { pushToast } = useToast();
  const { data: event, isLoading, isError, error } = useEvent(id);
  const joinMutation = useJoinEvent();
  const leaveMutation = useLeaveEvent();
  const deleteMutation = useDeleteEvent();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingSpinner />;
  if (isError || !event) return <ErrorBanner message={getErrorMessage(error) || 'Event not found.'} />;

  async function handleJoin() {
    try {
      await joinMutation.mutateAsync(event!.id);
      pushToast('You joined the event!', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(e), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function handleLeave() {
    try {
      await leaveMutation.mutateAsync(event!.id);
      pushToast('You left the event.', 'info');
    } catch (e) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(e), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function handleDelete() {
    if (!window.confirm('Cancel this event? Participants will be notified.')) return;
    try {
      await deleteMutation.mutateAsync(event!.id);
      pushToast('Event cancelled.', 'info');
      navigate('/');
    } catch (e) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(e), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="event-detail">
      <span className={`badge badge--${event.status.toLowerCase()}`}>{event.status}</span>
      <h2>{event.title}</h2>
      <p>
        {event.sportType} · {new Date(event.startTime).toLocaleString()} · {event.durationMinutes} min
      </p>
      <p>{event.addressLabel}</p>
      <p>{event.description}</p>
      <p>
        {event.currentParticipants}/{event.maxParticipants} participants
      </p>

      <div className="event-detail__actions">
        {!isAuthenticated && <p>Log in to join this event.</p>}

        {isAuthenticated &&
          !event.isOwnedByCurrentUser &&
          event.status === 'OPEN' &&
          !event.isJoinedByCurrentUser && (
            <button onClick={handleJoin} disabled={joinMutation.isPending}>
              Join event
            </button>
          )}

        {isAuthenticated && event.isJoinedByCurrentUser && !event.isOwnedByCurrentUser && (
          <button onClick={handleLeave} disabled={leaveMutation.isPending}>
            Leave event
          </button>
        )}

        {isAuthenticated && event.isOwnedByCurrentUser && (
          <>
            <button onClick={() => navigate(`/events/${event.id}/edit`)}>Edit event</button>
            <button className="danger" onClick={handleDelete} disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}>
              Cancel event
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

    try {
      const event = await createMutation.mutateAsync(payload);
      pushToast('Event created!', 'success');
      navigate(`/events/${event.id}`);
    } catch (e) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(e), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="page-form">
      <h2>Create a new event</h2>
      <EventForm
        defaultLocation={position ?? undefined}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        submitLabel="Create event"
        isSubmitting={createMutation.isPending}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

```tsx
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { EventForm } from '../components/events/EventForm';
import { useEvent, useUpdateEvent } from '../hooks/useEvents';
import { useToast } from '../components/common/ToastContext';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import { LoadingSpinner } from '../components/common/LoadingSpinner';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';
import type { CreateEventRequest } from '../types/api';

export function EditEventPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: event, isLoading, isError, error } = useEvent(id);
  const updateMutation = useUpdateEvent(id ?? '');
  const { pushToast } = useToast();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingSpinner />;
  if (isError || !event) return <ErrorBanner message={getErrorMessage(error) || 'Event not found.'} />;
  if (!event.isOwnedByCurrentUser) {
    return <ErrorBanner message="You are not allowed to edit this event." />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(payload: CreateEventRequest) {
    try {
      await updateMutation.mutateAsync(payload);
      pushToast('Event updated.', 'success');
      navigate(`/events/${id}`);
    } catch (e) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(e), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="page-form">
      <h2>Edit event</h2>
      <EventForm
        initialValue={event}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        submitLabel="Save changes"
        isSubmitting={updateMutation.isPending}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

### `frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';

interface LocationState {
  from?: { pathname: string };
}

export function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login({ email, password });
      const state = location.state as LocationState | null;
      navigate(state?.from?.pathname ?? '/', { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="auth-page">
      <h2>Log in</h2>
      <ErrorBanner message={error} />
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <label>
          Email
          <input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} required />
        </label>
        <label>
          Password
          <input
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            required
            minLength={8}
          />
        </label>
        <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
          {submitting ? 'Logging in…' : 'Log in'}
        </button>
      </form>
      <p>
        No account? <Link to="/register">Sign up</Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

### `frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';

export function RegisterPage() {
  const { register, login } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  function validate(): string | null {
    if (password.length < 8) return 'Password must be at least 8 characters.';
    if (!displayName.trim()) return 'Display name is required.';
    return null;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const validationError = validate();
    if (validationError) {
      setError(validationError);
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await register({ email, password, displayName });
      // Register endpoint doesn't return a token — log in immediately after.
      await login({ email, password });
      navigate('/', { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="auth-page">
      <h2>Create an account</h2>
      <ErrorBanner message={error} />
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <label>
          Display name
          <input value={displayName} onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)} required maxLength={60} />
        </label>
        <label>
          Email
          <input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} required />
        </label>
        <label>
          Password
          <input
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            required
            minLength={8}
          />
        </label>
        <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
          {submitting ? 'Creating account…' : 'Sign up'}
        </button>
      </form>
      <p>
        Already have an account? <Link to="/login">Log in</Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

### `frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useJoinedEvents, useMe, useOrganizedEvents, useUpdateMe } from '../hooks/useUser';
import { EventCard } from '../components/events/EventCard';
import { LoadingSpinner } from '../components/common/LoadingSpinner';
import { ErrorBanner } from '../components/common/ErrorBanner';
import { getErrorMessage } from '../lib/errorUtils';
import { useToast } from '../components/common/ToastContext';
import type { SportType } from '../types/api';

const SPORT_OPTIONS: SportType[] = ['FOOTBALL', 'BASKETBALL', 'TENNIS', 'VOLLEYBALL', 'RUNNING', 'OTHER'];

export function ProfilePage() {
  const { data: me, isLoading, isError, error } = useMe();
  const updateMutation = useUpdateMe();
  const { data: organized } = useOrganizedEvents();
  const { data: joined } = useJoinedEvents();
  const { pushToast } = useToast();

  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('');
  const [preferredSports, setPreferredSports] = useState<SportType[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (me) {
      setDisplayName(me.displayName);
      setPreferredSports(me.preferredSports ?? []);
    }
  }, [me]);

  function toggleSport(sport: SportType) {
    setPreferredSports((prev) => (prev.includes(sport) ? prev.filter((s) => s !== sport) : [...prev, sport]));
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await updateMutation.mutateAsync({ displayName, preferredSports, homeLocation: me?.homeLocation });
      pushToast('Profile updated.', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      pushToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    }
  }

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingSpinner />;
  if (isError || !me) return <ErrorBanner message={getErrorMessage(error)} />;

  return (
    <div className="profile-page">
      <h2>My Profile</h2>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="profile-page__form">
        <label>
          Display name
          <input value={displayName} onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)} required />
        </label>
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Preferred sports</legend>
          {SPORT_OPTIONS.map((sport) => (
            <label key={sport} className="checkbox-label">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={preferredSports.includes(sport)} onChange={() => toggleSport(sport)} />
              {sport}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
        <button type="submit" disabled={updateMutation.isPending}>
          {updateMutation.isPending ? 'Saving…' : 'Save profile'}
        </button>
      </form>

      <section>
        <h3>Events I'm organizing</h3>
        <div className="event-list">
          {organized?.length ? (
            organized.map((ev) => <EventCard key={ev.id} event={ev} />)
          ) : (
            <p>No organized events yet.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h3>Events I've joined</h3>
        <div className="event-list">
          {joined?.length ? joined.map((ev) => <EventCard key={ev.id} event={ev} />) : <p>No joined events yet.</p>}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend/src/App.tsx`

```tsx
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AppLayout } from './components/layout/AppLayout';
import { ProtectedRoute } from './components/layout/ProtectedRoute';
import { LoginPage } from './pages/LoginPage';
import { RegisterPage } from './pages/RegisterPage';
import { LoadingSpinner } from './components/common/LoadingSpinner';

// Lazy-load the map bundle (Leaflet + clustering) and other heavier pages
// to keep the initial load under the <2s / 4G target from the architecture doc.
const MapPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/MapPage').then((m) => ({ default: m.MapPage })));
const EventDetailPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/EventDetailPage').then((m) => ({ default: m.EventDetailPage })));
const CreateEventPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/CreateEventPage').then((m) => ({ default: m.CreateEventPage })));
const EditEventPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/EditEventPage').then((m) => ({ default: m.EditEventPage })));
const ProfilePage = lazy(() => import('./pages/ProfilePage').then((m) => ({ default: m.ProfilePage })));

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<LoadingSpinner />}>
      <Routes>
        <Route element={<AppLayout />}>
          <Route path="/" element={<MapPage />} />
          <Route path="/events/:id" element={<EventDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
          <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />

          <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
            <Route path="/events/new" element={<CreateEventPage />} />
            <Route path="/events/:id/edit" element={<EditEventPage />} />
            <Route path="/profile" element={<ProfilePage />} />
          </Route>
        </Route>
      </Routes>
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

import { StrictMode } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import App from './App';
import { queryClient } from './lib/queryClient';
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext';
import { ToastProvider } from './components/common/ToastContext';
import './styles/index.css';

const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (!rootElement) throw new Error('Root element not found');

createRoot(rootElement).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <BrowserRouter>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <AuthProvider>
          <ToastProvider>
            <App />
          </ToastProvider>
        </AuthProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </BrowserRouter>
  </StrictMode>
);

### `frontend/Dockerfile`

```dockerfile
# ---- Stage 1: build the static bundle ----
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY . .

ARG VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api
ENV VITE_API_BASE_URL=$VITE_API_BASE_URL

RUN npm run build

# ---- Stage 2: serve with Nginx ----
FROM nginx:1.25-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

### `frontend/nginx.conf`

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name _;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;

    # SSE stream needs buffering disabled and a long read timeout to stay open.
    location /api/notifications/stream {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8080/api/notifications/stream;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Connection '';
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        chunked_transfer_encoding off;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }

    # All other backend REST calls.
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8080/api/;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # SPA fallback so client-side routes (react-router) work on refresh/deep-link.
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|svg|woff2?)$ {
        expires 30d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
}
```

### `frontend/README.md`

```md
# SportConnect Frontend

React 18 + Vite + TypeScript SPA implementing the SportConnect map/events/notifications UI
per the architecture document.

## Local development

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env   # adjust VITE_API_BASE_URL if backend isn't proxied
npm run dev
```

The Vite dev server proxies `/api/*` to `http://localhost:8080` (see `vite.config.ts`).
Ensure the Spring Boot backend is running on port 8080, or override the proxy target.

## Build

```bash
npm run build
npm run preview
```

## Docker

```bash
docker build -t sportconnect-frontend .
docker run -p 8081:80 sportconnect-frontend
```

In `docker-compose.yml`, this service should sit on the same network as `backend`
(the Nginx config proxies `/api/*` to `http://backend:8080`).

## Known integration point to confirm with Backend

`GET /api/notifications/stream` requires authentication, but the browser `EventSource`
API cannot send custom `Authorization` headers. This client authenticates by appending
`?access_token=<jwt>` to the stream URL. **Backend must accept the token via this query
param** on the SSE endpoint (in addition to/instead of the `Authorization` header) for
notifications to work correctly.

## Notable implementation choices

- **Auth**: JWT stored in `localStorage`, attached via Axios request interceptor. A 401
  response anywhere triggers a global `auth:unauthorized` event that logs the user out
  gracefully (no crash loop, falls back to guest/read-only browsing).
- **Realtime**: `useNotifications` hook manages a single `EventSource`, closing it on
  `visibilitychange` (tab hidden) and reconnecting with exponential backoff (max 5
  attempts) when the tab becomes visible again.
- **Map**: Leaflet + `react-leaflet` + `react-leaflet-cluster`, lazy-loaded as its own
  chunk to protect the <2s initial load target.
- **Data fetching**: TanStack Query for caching; SSE handlers invalidate the relevant
  query keys (`events`, `events/{id}`) so REST state and push notifications stay in sync.
```
